remarks: Third floor type "E" two bedroom/two bath unit. This is a fractional ownership which gives you 10-11 weeks per year, or about 1 week per month. Weeks rotate each year so in a 5-6 year cycle you should get all holiday and festival weeks. Ownership amenities include year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, 2 hot tubs, fitness room, private owner locker room, private owner's lounge, valet parking anytime you are here, and garage access while lodging overnight on a first come, first serve basis. Discounts available at Edna's, the pro shop, and on daily lift tickets. Lovely view overlooking the slopes and hole #9 on the golf course.
